Source-only request5cfbf6a4-788f-4f8f-b2ff-19b67ba152ec completed once on preserved codex/save-destination-swift. New test-only commit3ca3e9c9 atop0f820dff; original product3d4b34f4 unchanged. Two files only: DocumentSaveDestinationCommitTests.swift and EngineDocumentBackendTests.swift. git diff --check passes; NO B compiler/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat restart. All added assertions UNRUN.

1. testForcedExclusiveRenameFallbackCollisionPreservesSentinelAndRemovesStage loops ENOSYS/EINVAL; forced hook invocation is counted by per-case semaphore, real helper returns destinationExists, sentinel bytes/inode unchanged, directory contains only sentinel (own stage removed). Existing successful fallback/cleanup-failure controls retained.
2. testDirtyCheckedSaveConflictAtDifferentTargetPreservesIdentityAndSavedMarker first saves original tiny4x4, adds committed unsaved layer, collides with separate sentinel target, asserts original path/title/dirty/history, both original/sentinel bytes preserved; missing-parent requires ordinary bridged DocumentError. Undo reaches earlier saved node and is clean, pinning saved-marker preservation. Existing checked mapping test's missing-parent assertion also strengthened to DocumentError type.

A independent review found no product blocker in0f820dff, but no compile/runtime acceptance inferred. A owns focused/full/GUI gates when Smart Preview lane frees and sole main merge. No overlap with Smart Preview source. Exact incremental handoff is3ca3e9c9; no original implementation rerun/reset.
